fusions.name: Swarm Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to every enemy in it. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Scavenge the Fallen
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Deals 16 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Duckling Brood
fusions.desc: A bonded duckling paddles beside you and nips an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second.
